plan.title: Reverse Auction Auto Title for Two Locations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure a buy-side price-based auction, matching the reverse auction scenario.
Choose the buy/reverse auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Verify the expected auction template is applied.
Add the first row for the specified product.
Set the first product row's location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Capture the generated one-location title before adding the second row.
Add the second row for the same product.
Set the second product row's location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the automatic title updates when the second location row is added.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - 2 locations

steps.note: Verify the exact expected automatic title for two locations.
Remove the second row to test that the automatic title responds to row removal.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the title returns to the prior one-location value after removing the second row.
Restore the second product row for the final two-location state.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - 2 locations

steps.note: Confirm the final two-location title is regenerated without entering a custom title.
